office: a Public Service Hall or a territorial office of the Public Service Development Agency
note: The Public Service Development Agency's page: a citizen who has reached 14 must obtain one within six months (not abroad), and one may be issued under 14; the fees by term; photos at the Agency cost GEL 5 more (not modelled), and students, people with disabilities and some others pay less (not modelled). The card's term isn't on the page, so it's null.

sources.title: Public Service Development Agency (Georgia), Identity card
sources.said: A Georgian citizen having reached 14 years of age is obliged to obtain an identity card within the term of 6 months. Identity card may also be issued to a Georgian citizen under the age of 14. ... On the 10 th working day – GEL 60; On the 5 th working day – GEL 80; On the 3 rd working day – GEL 100; On the 2 nd working day – GEL 120; On the same day – GEL 150.
